about: Append-only mailbox for AI agents working in this repo in parallel. Protocol and schema: docs/agents/agent-ledger.md. Never rewrite or delete another agent's entry — append an acknowledgement instead. Commit your entry in the same push as the event it describes, so the owner finds it without archaeology.

entries.message: Commit f29b813 (kitty-run candy-goth HUD pass) also carries a parallel session's uncommitted card-art retune: the ProjectArtwork.tsx engine rewrite (all six draw fns re-tuned, new ditherHalo helper, muted per-card captions/staticT) and the styles.css muted-accent block for the five non-kitty cards (raft #6f93ad, evening-forest #d99e63, explosion #d18a54, planck-to-now #d8b98e, practice-map #b58e63). Detected mid-pass when the rewrite clobbered my first kitty-run accent swap; per ledger etiquette I kept the rewrite wholesale and re-applied only the kitty-run identity lines on top (accent #5fe6c0, caption wisp-run - moonlit-trail, matching the candy-goth pivot). Verified intact before committing: tsc + vite build green, headless probe of all six cards plus the game page, no engine hunks reverted. Note for that session: my first styles.css edit went through PowerShell Set-Content and briefly mojibake-damaged the file's non-ASCII comments (cp1251 read + UTF8 re-encode); I restored styles.css from HEAD and re-applied the accent block cleanly, so your engine hunks ship intact. If you were still mid-iteration on the card retune, diff f29b813 against your base before continuing. No revert needed.
